# CrazyGames

> CrazyGames is a free HTML5 and arcade game portal offering thousands of instantly playable online games across multiple genres without downloads or installations.

CrazyGames serves as a comprehensive game discovery platform powered by HTML5 technology, featuring categories, tags, and a curated catalog of free online games including popular titles like Geometry Dash BeatBox, World Cup 2018, and Baby in Yellow. The platform prioritizes accessibility and user experience through intuitive browsing and support channels.

## Game Discovery & Browsing

- [Homepage](https://www.crazygames.com.es): CrazyGames homepage with free online HTML5 games, arcade titles, and daily new releases.
- [Categories](https://www.crazygames.com.es/categories): Game category browsing hub organizing thousands of free online titles by genre.
- [Tags](https://www.crazygames.com.es/tags): Tag-based game discovery directory for browsing free HTML5 and arcade games.

## Featured Games

- [Geometry Dash BeatBox](https://www.crazygames.com.es/game/geometry-dash-beatbox): Geometry Dash BeatBox rhythm platformer with music-synced jump mechanics.
- [World Cup 2018](https://www.crazygames.com.es/game/world-cup-2018): World Cup 2018 free online soccer game with penalty shootout gameplay.
- [Baby in Yellow](https://www.crazygames.com.es/game/baby-in-yellow): Baby in Yellow spooky horror puzzle game with caregiving and escape mechanics.
- [BloxdHop.io](https://www.crazygames.com.es/game/bloxdhop-io): BloxdHop.io 3D parkour runner with jumping and obstacle dodging gameplay.
- [Motorcycle Stunt Racing 2025](https://www.crazygames.com.es/game/motorcycle-stunt-racing-2025): Motorcycle Stunt Racing 2025 arcade racing game with tricks and extreme tracks.
